criteria.name: Register match
criteria.reason: All-caps button label for a low-stakes action follows the approved pattern in LEM-011. The register is appropriate for the stakes level.

criteria.name: Humour boundary
criteria.reason: No humour is present. The copy contains only a concrete action verb appropriate for low-stakes interface copy.

criteria.name: Plain language calibration
criteria.reason: The draft contains no specialized insurance or coverage terminology to evaluate for selective translation. It is a simple action label.

criteria.name: Direct address
criteria.reason: The interface provides no named subject (like a pet or policyholder name) to address in this single button label, so direct address cannot be evaluated.

criteria.name: Character budget
criteria.reason: No declared interface character limit was provided with this draft, so fit cannot be assessed.

criteria.name: Action verb consistency
criteria.reason: 'GET MY QUOTE' uses the concrete verb 'get', consistent with approved examples like 'GET DISCOUNTS', and personalizes it with 'my' which fits the flow of requesting a quote.

compliance.reason: The draft consists solely of a button/navigation-style label ('GET MY QUOTE'). It contains no promise of an outcome, no removal of a required disclaimer, no unsupported judgement claim about a customer, no contradiction of known policy, and no attributed quote or factual public claim requiring a source. Per instructions, an isolated navigation or button label should not be failed for lacking surrounding context, source, or disclaimer. No compliance prohibition is triggered.
